# Roozaneh Net — Official V2Ray & Xray Client Download Hub (پرتال دانلود مستقیم کلاینت‌های روزنه نت)

> Official, malware-free client download portal for V2Ray, Xray-core, and Sing-box applications across Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux. All Android/desktop binaries are mirrored directly from official upstream GitHub releases; iOS clients link directly to the official Apple App Store.

## Core Guarantees & Policies
- Multi-Device Simultaneous Use: Supported on all plans under fair-use policy (مصرف منصفانه و خانوادگی).
- 2X Automatic SLA Compensation: Automatic up to 2X expiry extension for verified global outages exceeding 3 hours.
- 24-Hour Money-Back Guarantee: Full refund under 2 GB initial usage if connectivity issues cannot be resolved; pro-rated refund above 2 GB.
- 100% Data Rollover: Unused traffic transfers 100% to the next cycle on renewal (30-day post-expiry retention window).
- 100% Manual Renewal: Zero auto-billing or recurring deductions.
- Strict No-Logs Architecture: Xray `loglevel: "none"`, no netfilter/conntrack connection logs, encrypted in-memory DoH DNS.
